The '''OT-12 Enforcer Droid''' was a large, six-legged [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droid]] model produced by the [[Okara Droid Company]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. OT-12 Enforcer Droids were among the [[Droid/Legends|droids]] that defended the [[Okara Droid Factory]] from attack.
